Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class StepUpAuthorizationRequestConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.StepUpAuthorizationRequestConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationConverter
public class StepUpAuthorizationRequestConverter extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationConverter
Applies the OpenID Connect step-up parameters of an authorization request to the authentication of the session. It is installed first among the converters of /oauth2/authorize and never converts anything: it either lets the request go on (returning null) or refuses it. The factors and their instants are read through the FactorTimeline, so a remembered (trusted) device never counts here.
  • max_age: when the primary factor was presented more than that many whole seconds ago, a ReauthenticationRequiredException makes the user sign in again. A session whose factors are unknown (no counted factor of the registry) is left alone, because it could never satisfy the request and the user would loop through the login page.
  • acr_values: when the request asks only for classes of AuthenticationContextClass that the session has not reached, a step-up SecondFactorRequiredException sends the user to the second-factor page, which then asks for a real second factor even on a trusted device. The multi-factor class also satisfies a request for the password class. Classes this server does not know are ignored, as the specification makes acr_values voluntary.
